# Assembler aliases

[← dictionary index](index.md)

A mnemonic that assembles to another instruction. One mnemonic is one instruction (section 9.18); the disassembler never prints an alias.

*Generated by `tools/mkmanual.py` from `spec/grammars.d`; do not edit.*

| Written | Assembles to | Group |
|---|---|---|
| `BHIS` | `BCC` | `branch` |
| `BLO` | `BCS` | `branch` |
| `CBHIS` | `CBCC` | `cbranch` |
| `CBLO` | `CBCS` | `cbranch` |
| `MULU` | `MUL` | `alu` |
